primary_metric_justification: Average Precision (AP / PR-AUC) measures the full precision-recall tradeoff across the candidate pool, properly accounting for severe target imbalance (32 positives among 4,643 eligible planets).

selected_production_model.algorithm: Regularized Logistic Regression (Balanced L2, Standardized Log-Transformed Features)

score_diversity.tie_breaking_policy: Deterministic multi-key tie-breaker: 1. Raw continuous score descending; 2. TSM descending; 3. Distance ascending; 4. Planet name ascending.

calibration.calibration_statement: Scores represent prioritized ranking scores designed for spectroscopic telescope follow-up, NOT uncalibrated posterior probabilities. Because balanced class weighting (class_weight='balanced') was applied to address severe 0.69% positive prevalence, output scores strictly optimize target ordering.

limitations: small n: only 32 positive JWST transmission spectroscopy targets currently confirmed in public approved programs.
label = human selection: targets reflect human TAC selection and telescope observing pressure rather than pure physical ground truth.
bias toward bright, well-studied targets: host stars in confirmed programs are systematically brighter (lower J/K magnitudes) and closer than average catalog stars.
